source.select_year: The immediate next calendar year 2017 after the opened 2016 positive; chosen before opening any 2017 GPS height values. No multiple-year outcome search.

climate.provider: Open-Meteo CERRA ~5km archive model cerra; hourly wind_speed_100m, units m/s, UTC
climate.sites: Exactly 4 2016 reference colony centroids (2016-deployment median, not reselected from 2017 bird outcome support); original 2016 source receipt artifact 12250561258.
climate.class: lower 25%, upper 25% of valid calendar-day mean wind WITHIN site×month; middle excluded.
climate.grid_randomization: Shared exact gridded-site wind label shuffles within month; independent per-grid, 999 draws, new seed 20261021.

preprocessing.bird_ID: archival study reference exact ID crosswalk required ≥95%, no fuzzy alias; keep only original four colony sites
preprocessing.UTC_day_thinning: earliest non-outlier, speed+valid-xy GPS per bird×5-minute-bin BEFORE altitude QC
preprocessing.native_height: height-above-msl, finite [-300,3000]m; ≥80% of preselected flight fixes
preprocessing.relative_height: subtract each target bird-UTC-day median (post-session shape estimation)
preprocessing.comparison: same bird other day at same 5km cell: same wind vs all winds, each day equal within donor, Jeffreys 0.5/category
preprocessing.require_donors: ≥10 own-other-day 5min records in the SAME wind state AND ≥10 in OPPOSITE wind state in each scored cell
preprocessing.scoring: evaluation bird-day ≥20 fixes; individual at least2 separately scored LOW days and2 HIGH days; equal LOW-HIGH bird scores then equal birds

calibration.p_value: upper bound accounting for invalid randomizations, p=(1+null>=observed+unavailable)/1000
calibration.direction: observed context gain>valid null mean; p_upper<.05

rules: Do not use any 2017 altitude or vertical response in admission/choice of weather grid, source year, or cutoffs.
Same Movebank study and many possibly shared individual tags across years: temporal replication only, NOT independent study/taxon proof.
A negative or underpowered result is retained, with no switch to 2018 to rescue.
Retain observational regional wind measurement limitation and date/month confounding; no causal wind flight mechanism identified.
first_step: Run outcome-blind x-y+wind feasibility and verify 2016 site's exact weather grid data are accessible in 2017; only then open year 2017 heights.
